schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides health insurance for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Accident insurance scheme offering coverage for accidental death and disability.

schemes.name: National Health Mission (NHM)
schemes.description: NHM encompasses two sub-missions: National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).

faqs.question: Is PM-JAY completely free?
faqs.answer: Yes, for eligible beneficiaries, all costs of hospitalization are covered up to ₹5 Lakhs.

faqs.question: Does it cover pre-existing diseases?
faqs.answer: Yes, PM-JAY covers all pre-existing conditions from Day 1.
